$comment: Pinned transcribe.cpp source for sigil_transcribe.dll (P1-G2; docs/adr/0003b-transcribe-cpp.md).
build.ps1 downloads the archive once into %LOCALAPPDATA%/sigil-dev-cache/transcribe.cpp/, refuses it unless sha256 and size match, and extracts it without the upstream agent/CI folders.

Upgrade: change tag, commit, version, abihash and the archive pin together, re-read include/transcribe.h for ABI changes (0.x breaks on minor releases), rebuild every variant, re-run the ignored speech_rt::transcribe tests, and bump shim_revision if shim.cpp changed.
name: transcribe.cpp

cuda.$comment: Turing (RTX 20 / GTX 16), Ampere (RTX 30), Ada (RTX 40) and Blackwell (RTX 50) as native code; compute_80 PTX lets the driver JIT anything newer or in between. CUDA 13 dropped Maxwell, Pascal and Volta, matching the ORT CUDA 13 floor (ADR 0001).
